subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL gain measured duration/start-end fields, and which reported event types should become lifecycle spans versus remain point events?
rationale: Changing trajectory rows from timestamped events into duration-bearing spans affects an exported diagnostic schema, support tooling, docs, and transcript-derived tool event semantics.

options.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds measured duration fields for real lifecycle operations with docs and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep trajectory event-only
options.body: Leave trajectory JSONL as a point-event timeline and update docs to direct latency analysis to OTel diagnostics instead.

options.title: Split by event family
options.body: Track runtime lifecycle timing separately from transcript-derived tool call/result reconstruction so each family can use the right schema.

recommendation.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds measured duration fields for real lifecycle operations with docs and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame ties the present trajectory schema and recorder call sites to this recent area work, making them the best available routing owner from local evidence.
